701909.t: From ἀ- (a-, “un-”) + σέβομαι (sébomai, “I feel awe”) + -ής (-ḗs, adjective suffix).

701964.t: Of unknown origin. Perhaps related to ἀσκός (askós, “skin, hide”), thus with original meaning "to prepare a skin".

701991.t: For the “shield” sense, traditionally derived from ἀ- (a-) + σπίζω (spízō, “to extend”).

701987.t: Uncertain. Could be related to σπάω (spắō, “to draw; to pull”).

701968.t: Unknown. The variant points to foreign or Pre-Greek origin.

701988.t: Solmsen connected σπαλύσσεται (spalússetai, “to rip, agitate”) and σφαλάσσειν (sphalássein, “to cut, sting”), but this is semantically unconvincing. It is rather a Pre-Greek word in view of the suffix, typical of plant names.
